classification.difficultyReason: Recognise the exposed annulus around the narrower cylinder, exclude the shared circular join, and combine that annulus with the cylinder top and both curved surfaces. The top and annulus may alternatively be combined as one larger circle.

inlines.text: The top section is a cylinder with a height of 3 cm and a diameter of 4 cm.
The bottom section is a hemisphere with a diameter of 6 cm.
The cylinder is centred on the flat surface of the hemisphere.
Find the total surface area of the composite solid in

spec.description: An upright cylinder centred on the flat upper face of a lower hemisphere. The cylinder top and exposed annulus are visible. The rear cylinder contact arc is dashed; the rear hemisphere rim is occluded by the cylinder between its sides. Ordinary outlines and labels use black with no shading.
spec.mathematics: Cylinder radius 2 cm and height 3 cm; hemisphere radius 3 cm. Orthographic elevation uses rim flattening 0.25. The hemisphere silhouette has horizontal radius 3 and vertical radius 3 sqrt(1-0.25^2). The cylinder contact disc is internal and excluded from surface area.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied geometry and the labels 4 cm, 3 cm and 6 cm are visible.
